hypotheses.hypothesis: Killing the checkout pod will cause the checkout service to be unavailable, leading to failed order placement.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: checkout is the entry service for the order workflow; its pod is the only replica.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: The workflow requires 10 consecutive successful order responses; killing checkout will break this invariant.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject pod_kill on workload/checkout, observe order responses, then recover.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After pod restart, checkout service becomes available and workflow succeeds.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Killing the cart pod will make the cart service unavailable, causing checkout to fail when adding items or retrieving cart.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: cart is a supporting service for the checkout workflow; its pod is the only replica.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: The workflow requires cart operations to succeed; killing cart will break this invariant.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject pod_kill on workload/cart, observe order responses, then recover.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After pod restart, cart service becomes available and workflow succeeds.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Introducing 500ms network delay to checkout pod will cause timeouts in the checkout service, leading to failed order responses.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: checkout is the entry service; high latency may cause client timeouts.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: The workflow requires 10 consecutive successful order responses; delay may cause timeouts and break invariant.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject network_delay on workload/checkout, observe order responses, then recover.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After delay removal, checkout service returns to normal and workflow succeeds.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Introducing 500ms network delay to cart pod will cause timeouts in cart service, affecting checkout's cart operations.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: cart is a supporting service; high latency may cause checkout to fail.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: The workflow requires cart operations to succeed; delay may cause timeouts and break invariant.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject network_delay on workload/cart, observe order responses, then recover.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After delay removal, cart service returns to normal and workflow succeeds.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Introducing 50% network loss to checkout pod will cause intermittent failures in checkout service, leading to failed order responses.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: checkout is the entry service; packet loss may cause request failures.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: The workflow requires 10 consecutive successful order responses; loss will break this invariant.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject network_loss on workload/checkout, observe order responses, then recover.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After loss removal, checkout service returns to normal and workflow succeeds.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Introducing 50% network loss to cart pod will cause intermittent failures in cart service, affecting checkout's cart operations.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: cart is a supporting service; packet loss may cause checkout to fail.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: The workflow requires cart operations to succeed; loss will break this invariant.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject network_loss on workload/cart, observe order responses, then recover.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After loss removal, cart service returns to normal and workflow succeeds.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stressing the checkout container CPU will cause performance degradation, leading to timeouts and failed order responses.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: checkout is the entry service; CPU starvation may cause slow processing.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: The workflow requires 10 consecutive successful order responses; CPU stress may cause timeouts and break invariant.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject container_cpu_stress on workload/checkout, observe order responses, then recover.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After stress removal, checkout service returns to normal and workflow succeeds.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stressing the cart container CPU will cause performance degradation, affecting checkout's cart operations.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: cart is a supporting service; CPU starvation may cause slow responses.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: The workflow requires cart operations to succeed; CPU stress may cause timeouts and break invariant.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject container_cpu_stress on workload/cart, observe order responses, then recover.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: After stress removal, cart service returns to normal and workflow succeeds.
